Python/CPython/pip route SDK evidence to actual published Python API/quickstart; no alternate-interpreter guarantee.
Node.js/Node/JavaScript/TypeScript/npm identify the Node SDK. They do not promise browser/Electron/Bun support.
Rust/Cargo/crate identify actual Rust public package, distinct from natural language.
First deck/card, beginner and initial tutorial point to complete public install/run/export tasks.
API/method/function/signature/type-declaration aliases find actual API references; no method name invented.
Install/setup/dependency terms target real public package setup and quickstarts with native prerequisites.
Source/local compile/repository/Maturin identify source-build workflow, kept separate from public registry installations.
Library alternatives/vs/differences locate balanced genanki comparison; stable identity not claimed exclusive.
Migration/transition/previous API aliases locate deliberate API/identity migration and documented limits, not compatibility shims.
Update/new version/history aliases require actual update/publication/version/baseline context; ordinary study/repaso alone does not become distribution-update intent.
Original APKG, re-export and identity-evidence aliases locate a constraint topic. Re-export matching is not approval of an Anki re-export baseline.
Stable keys/GUID/namespace/business-key aliases match explicit identity concepts without promising override of newer local edits.
Errors/failures/missing/no-load/disappearing aliases describe actual structured troubleshooting and output-lifetime conditions.
Media/attachments map to caller-supplied owned data, not automatic discovery from arbitrary HTML.
Image/photo/illustration synonyms describe supplied media image content and image occlusion; no image generation/OCR promise.
Audio/sound/voice/pronunciation/MP3/WAV are media intents. Importing supplied speech recordings is possible; these aliases do not add TTS or make the synthesized tone a spoken word.
Occlusion/mask/rectangle aliases match caller-defined rectangular masks on an owned decoded image, not automatic image-label detection.
Gap/omission/completing terms match explicit Cloze syntax and card numbering1–500.
Template/bundle/CSS/font aliases match real model/bundle/static asset support; fuente is potentially broad Spanish vocabulary but adds no source-build capability.
Custom models/fields/conditional generation/required fields map to actual immutable NoteType/Field/Template API.
Platforms/requirements/Alpine/musl/Electron/Bun locate recorded-verification boundaries. Matching unsupported/unverified environments is not a support guarantee.
Spreadsheet/Excel/table terms point to the Python caller-parser recipe. XLSX must first become UTF8 CSV; no XLSX SDK converter.
JSON/structured data refer to caller parsing using serde_json/json.loads/JSON.parse, then authoring/building.
AI/assistant/draft/notes-to-cards refer to reviewed assistant drafts and local SDK generation, no hosted model call or factual correctness guarantee.
Plain text/HTML/escaping map to explicit Content.text/Content.html and dependency-preserving typed composition.
Definition/relationship/grouping terms require note/card/deck/Project/APKG/fields/models context, matching real note/card/deck distinctions.
Content/includes/inside/composition require APKG/package/export context; locating package structure is not an arbitrary HTML assets discovery feature.
Study/review/practice/questions is weak0.25 evidence and has no update role, preserving distinction between learning and publishing updates.
Custom/design terms require fields/front/back/template/model/notetype context; a general basic card question is not automatically a schema task.
Add/create/extend requires field/notetype/model context and then maps to real custom-schema task.
Quantity/multiple/count terms require BOTH note and card contexts. Actual Basic1→1, Cloze repeatednumbers and custom multiple templates distinguish note/card counts; no blanket equality.
Hide/cover verbs require visual image/diagram/photo/drawing context; appropriate IO discovery without claiming automatic region inference.
New weak0.35 intent requires BOTH SDK token and card/deck/APKG object. Finds SDK complete creation workflow without dominating more specific diagnostics/update/schema context.

Browser/web intent requires BOTH Node-family token AND runtime/package/support/use context, then points to compatibility. Browser card-template/HTML/CSS previews remain supported website behavior. The Node browser environment is outside recorded verification; this concept does not declare all browser previews impossible.
